g.text: SelfPrivacy-over-alternative-nets — install wizard flow (questions & data entered)
A. Local wizard (on your laptop — nothing on the box yet; type < to go back)
scan LAN + direct cable for the target
(how the box is reached from the internet)
(how the box gets online AFTER install)
= 0a cable→router / 0b home wifi / 0c other wifi / 0d wifi-only
B. INSTALL (irreversible — no questions, no back-nav)
netboot the target over the direct cable (UEFI PXE)
C. Finish (box rebooted onto its FINAL network)
reboot the box (wifi: unplug the cable)
read the box's LAN + public IP
no DNS — the provider supplies the public name
apply public access over SSH (nothing typed on the box) —
